findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 8 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: Example 9 mixes pronouns: "Mr. Faris ... where she deposits ... into his bank account". Mr. Faris is a man, so it should read "he deposits ... into his bank account". The solution also switches to "you would save"; it means Faris. The mathematics is not affected.

Book correction: The book prints "Example 8" and "Example 9" a second time here (after Example 9 above), so these two numbers each appear twice in the unit. In sequence they would be the 10th and 11th examples; we keep the printed numbers and label them "[printed again]".
Book correction: Example 8 [printed again], base case: the book prints "Total push-ups = 10 \times 1 - 10". It should read: Total push-ups = 10 = 1^{2} + 9(1).
